title: /etc/palm/phoenix/servers.json
description: Where a device finds the Phoenix platform and which keys it trusts: the one configuration every platform client reads (apps/shared/platform/src/servers.js resolves it). An image's is written at build time (meta-phoenix PHOENIX_* settings, tools/servers-json.py); the simulator's is services/account/etc/palm/phoenix/servers.json; with Developer Mode on, an override with the same shape is laid over it section by section. The platform serves its own at GET <api>/v1/servers.json, so a device in Developer Mode (or the conformance suite) can be pointed at it. A url may be relative: catalog, updates, revocations and drivers to feeds, the others to api. Plain http only for 127.0.0.1/localhost, or in Developer Mode's override.

feeds.description: Base address of the static feeds (feeds.<domain>/)

api.description: Base address of the device API (api.<domain>/); null: no account or cloud services

root.description: The offline root key that delegates to the online key (scope catalog)

channel.description: The channel a new device starts on

key.description: The driver catalog's key, pinned (never trusted on first use)

issuer.description: The OpenID Connect issuer (its /.well-known/openid-configuration); usually the API host without a trailing slash

key.description: The API's Ed25519 key that signs entitlements (else GET <api>/v1/key.json)
